verdict.rationale: Metorial is an MCP integration platform with a catalog of 1200+ integrations and hosted custom servers, so security scanning of listed servers is a fair question for it. The evidence shows only adjacent controls: admin-approved integrations, tool allow-filters, version pinning, and post-run trace review. Nothing documents the platform scanning or inspecting servers for malicious or vulnerable behavior before agents use them. The code-review-bot sample is a user-built app that analyzes git code, not platform vetting of servers.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can rely on the platform scanning or inspecting listed servers for malicious or vulnerable behavior before my agents use them
